--- Page 1 ---
Assure Chat — Master
Product & Technical
Specification
1. Executive Summary & Strategic
Context
Product Overview: Assure Chat is a lightweight, PLG chat interface built on a
deterministic document engine (JDF AST) designed for Legal, HR, and Compliance
professionals. It delivers "zero-collateral," atomic edits-updating only targeted
paragraphs without altering, hallucinating, or deleting untouched sections.
Engineering Purpose: Serves as a streamlined front door to existing JDF infrastructure,
fortifying backend APIs, decoupling AST logic from UI layers, and onboarding users to
node-based document workflows.
2. Marketing & Landing Page
Architecture
Hero Section
Eyebrow: FOR LEGAL, HR, & COMPLIANCE PROFESSIONALS
Headline: Stop Paying the AI "Proofreading Tax."
Subheadline: When you ask standard AI to change one clause, it rewrites the entire
contract-forcing you to re-read everything. Assure Chat is the only AI that makes atomic
edits. Change one paragraph. Keep the rest mathematically locked.
CTAs: Primary: "Start Editing for Free" I Secondary: "See How It Works"
The Problem: Regeneration Roulette
Standard AI creates collateral damage across long documents. Tweaking a single clause forces
full document regeneration, risking undetected hallucinations and wasting billable hours on
redundant proofreading.

--- Page 2 ---
The Solution: Zero-Collateral Editing
Atomic Updates: Only requested paragraphs are updated while the surrounding text
remains static.
Mathematical Locking: Previously approved clauses cannot be altered or dropped.
Instant Export: Frictionless, high-confidence export to PDF or DOCX without
full-document re-verification.
3-Step User Workflow
1. Draft: Generate standard policies, contracts, or memos.
2. Target: Specify precise modifications (e.g., "Make confidentiality term 3 years").
3. Export: Review targeted updates instantly and export clean files.
Pricing Structure
Free Tier ($0/mo): 3 Zero-Collateral Edits per month.
Pro Tier ($49/mo): Unlimited atomic edits and 1-click clean exports.
3. User Interface & Guided Workspace
Architecture
The UI operates as a state-driven guided workspace:
Phase 1: Setup State
Grounding via drag-and-drop zone (.txt or .md source upload).
Input prompt bar locked until source is attached.
Guided workflow replacing generic "New Draft" buttons.
Phase 2: Execution State
Real-time feedback overlay showing step-by-step progress (Ingest Source
Compile
Prompt
Z3 Logic Checks
Draft Document).
Transitions smoothly to rendered view upon SSE stream completion.
Phase 3: Audit Workspace (Tri-Pane Layout)
Left Pane (Context & History): Sources Tab (uploaded files preview) and Compiler Tab
(read-only audit trail of executed prompt).
Center Canvas (Rendered Document): Renders JDF nodes with provenance coloring

--- Page 3 ---
and docked refine bar for targeted edits.
Right Pane (Audit Hub):
Evidence Tab: Displays source filename, page, and verbatim quote for selected spans.
Red-Hat Tab: Highlights compliance risks and scrolls canvas to offending clauses.
Z3 Tab: Shows bounded logic proofs validating structural integrity.
Phase 4: Resolution & Split-Screen Comparison
Full-screen split view (50/50) with semantic diffing highlighting conceptual differences.
Line-item merging controls ([+ Use this block] / [Use this block -]) to create hybrid drafts.
4. Technical Specification & Engine
Architecture
LLM Architecture: JSON-Enforcing Data Router
The LLM acts strictly as a headless backend data-routing API translating natural language
requests into JSON payloads.
System Prompt Rules & Schema
Role: Headless, backend data-routing API. No conversational filler or explanations.
Format: Strict, raw JSON object (no markdown wrapping like ```json).
Schema:
JSON
{
"target_node_id": "string (exact ID of paragraph to change)",
"action_type": "string ('replace', 'delete', 'append')",
"new_text": "string (finalized node text)"
}
Error Handling: Returns {"status": "error"} on unparseable input.
Frontend Disguise & Micro-Interactions
JDF Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) nodes rendered seamlessly like plain text (<div
data-node-id="clause_4">).
Targeted shimmer/loading state on requested node only during edits.
Brief visual highlight (green fade) on update completion.
Contextual hovers ("Locked - Unchanged" VS. "Updated").

--- Page 4 ---
Native Redline Tracked-Changes Export
1-Click DOCX Export: Native Microsoft Word tracked changes (strikethroughs for
deletions, underlines for additions).
Embedded Rationale: Converts prompt instructions into native Word comments attached
to redlined clauses.
Scope Cuts (MVP Exclusions)
Exclude spatial dual-pane layouts from default chat.
Omit visible Z3 logic terminals and confidence badges in MVP.
No proactive adversarial ("Grill Me") interrogation flow.
